title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Spruce Soundboard Craft for Riffle’s full-app redesign. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Spruce Soundboard Craft
options.lineage: luthier spruce tops and morning workshop light
options.thesis: A bright practice shell finished like a pale spruce top: calm wood ground, forest-teal selection, and learning progress as growth rings you can read at a glance.
options.viewport: Operate shell: left nav on a tinted spruce rail, main work area with Up Next as a continuous timber action strip, and a growth-ring progress arc marking roadmap milestones beside today’s drill.
options.risk: Wood warmth can slide into generic ‘cream app’ if teal and ring geometry are underplayed.

raised.raise: Up Next reorders in place and holds a change highlight until noticed.
Roadmap reads as a disciplined corridor with open, active, complete, and locked states.
Type advances in decisive size steps so hierarchy never goes flat.
Skill and roadmap stages share one fixed scale so progress compares honestly.
BPM and difficulty remapping live-update the drill display like axes on one instrument.

options.riskDetail: Keep the ground cool-mist green-white, not yellow paper; let forest teal own selection and primary actions.

options.label: Daylight Practice Room
options.lineage: white-plaster practice rooms with window light
options.thesis: Riffle as a daylight room: white walls, soft spruce trim, and one clear desk for today’s practice.
options.viewport: Top bar brand + profile; primary column led by Resume Practice; side column for stats and recent scans — all on bright ground with teal CTAs.
options.risk: Also the direction most bright-learning apps land on; familiarity is the trade.

options.label: Gate Board Continuity
options.thesis: Practice continuity as a departure board: what is next stays lit until you act.
options.viewport: Segmented ‘pass’ for today’s session beside a ranked board of upcoming lessons that reorders live.
options.case: Beats spruce on product clarity for ‘what’s next’; loses on guitarist identification.
options.risk: Can feel airport-clinical if the wood warmth is stripped out entirely.

options.label: Bright Corridor Map
options.thesis: The roadmap is a bright corridor map: lines, stations, and clear transfers — never a dark enamel mural.
options.viewport: Shell with roadmap work area as the signature: active line highlighted, next station = next lesson.
options.case: Strong identification for journeys; clarity holds if kept as signature move only, not full costume.
options.risk: Midnight enamel would violate the brighter brief — this card is the daylit translation.

options.label: Live Axis Practice
options.thesis: Practice controls as live axes: drag difficulty or BPM and the whole drill thickens or eases in view.
options.viewport: Practice Room leads: giant chord or pattern, axis sliders remapping every glyph/step live; shell stays standard Operate.
options.case: Holds product clarity for the practice task; weaker whole-app identification than spruce.
options.risk: Reads as a type demo if the shell and roadmap lose hierarchy.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Coarse pixel letterforms at poster scale.
options.case: Loses both axes for a refined professional practice app.

options.label: Season Folio
options.thesis: Skill growth as fixed-scale seasonal plates.
options.case: Slips toward cream-editorial default; weaker as an Operate shell.
options.kept: Fixed-scale stage comparison for honest progress.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: Pastel roster of mascots ranked by popularity.
options.kept: Whole-cell roster reflow for finite collections (songs/chords).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean learning-product shell: bright ground, left nav, card dashboard, blue primary — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar + Overview with Resume card and stats — the arrangement visitors expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other learning apps by design.
